title: Quaintly Spiced Portuguese Chicken Curry
description: A tangy and festive Portuguese dish featuring massaman paste and ferment jang, this curry is a satvik friendly delight. It combines the warmth of spices with the coolness of yogurt and the crunch of fresh cilantro.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the massaman paste and ferment jang, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Stir in the plain yogurt and cook for 2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish the curry with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
